_comment: TigyWigy Learning Needs Analysis (LNA) template — complete before designing any new module or pathway.

businessContext.businessProblem: What business challenge or opportunity is driving this request?
businessContext.strategicAlignment: How does this learning need connect to organizational strategy?
businessContext.regulatoryDetails: If yes, which regulation and what is the compliance deadline?

desiredState.targetPerformanceLevel: Description of what employees should be able to do after learning
desiredState.timeframeForChange: Expected time to see behaviour change post-training

audience.accessToTechnology: Computer + LMS | Mobile only | Limited connectivity
audience.specialConsiderations: Any accessibility, cultural, or logistical factors

solutionRecommendation.recommendedFormat: eLearning | Workshop | Virtual Classroom | Blended | Coaching | OJT

constraints.existingContentToLeverage: List any existing training, policies, or resources
constraints.technologyConstraints: LMS version, authoring tool limitations, etc.
